checks.actual_text:
The team designed the models, chose the evaluation criteria, and made all methodological decisions.
We used ChatGPT and OpenAI Codex as programming, data-processing, and writing aids (code draft-
ing and review, post-processing, plotting, and English editing and typesetting). Claude was consulted
during model development; it proposed candidate lower-bound and decomposition arguments and the
ratio-placement idea, and reviewed our derivations. The team adopted these suggestions only after de-
riving and verifying them. All reported numbers come from the team’s own scheduler implementation
and saved schedules, validated by independent replay checks; no AI prototype output is reported as a
result. The team checked all AI-assisted content, calculations, code, and references for correctness and
plagiarism, and takes full responsibility for this report.
checks.expected_text: The team designed the models, chose the evaluation criteria, and made all methodological decisions. We used ChatGPT and OpenAI Codex as programming, data-processing, and writing aids (code drafting and review, post-processing, plotting, and English editing and typesetting). Claude was consulted during model development; it proposed candidate lower-bound and decomposition arguments and the ratio-placement idea, and reviewed our derivations. The team adopted these suggestions only after deriving and verifying them. All reported numbers come from the team's own scheduler implementation and saved schedules, validated by independent replay checks; no AI prototype output is reported as a result. The team checked all AI-assisted content, calculations, code, and references for correctness and plagiarism, and takes full responsibility for this report.
